title: Pan-Seared Tofu Bao
description: A simple and delicious French-inspired dish featuring crispy tofu and soft bao.
instructions: Cut the tofu into small cubes and season with salt and pepper.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the tofu to a baking sheet and bake for 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, toast the bao in the oven for 2-3 minutes.
In a small saucepan, heat the soy sauce and honey over low heat.
To assemble the dish, place a piece of bao on a plate, top with a few pieces of tofu, and drizzle with the soy sauce glaze.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.
